item.title: The revised NICE ME/CFS guideline: neither "robust" nor "thorough”
item.description: Agreement I do not AgreeBody People with ME/CFS have a serious condition with high symptom burden and impaired function. They deserve guidelines that favour good care and effective treatment supported by the best research evidence of efficacy and safety. Unfortunately, that is not what 2021 NICE guidelines have achieved. item.description: Agreement I do not AgreeBody Katisko et al. conducted a prospective study to evaluate the risk of mortality in patients with early onset dementia (EOD) (1).
